name: Yuki no Kanata ni
source:
I believed these ordinary peaceful days would last forever.

I had someone precious, something I had to protect…

But the end came suddenly.

During the shrine maiden’s ritual, demons attacked... the village barrier… was gone.

There was nothing I could do but watch.

When I awoke, the first thing that entered my sight… was the shrine maiden’s lifeless body.

Grieving deeply, the young man sets out on a journey to find her reincarnation.

Now… the story of the beginning of the end begins.

[Translated from Official Website]
